q1_comment: Carbon neutrality is mentioned only as a time reference ('time base'), not as an assessed or modeled pathway. The study assesses biomass energy potential (2-7% fossil fuel substitution), which does not constitute a climate-neutral system configuration.
q4_comment: Quantitative modeling (FLUS model) and scenarios are present, but designed to assess biomass energy potential under general development scenarios, not specifically to generate climate-neutral pathways.
